name: Touch of Weakness
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
You be far from home out here in the Bloodhoof Village, adventurer. I be sent here to find priests of my own tribe to send back to speak to our leaders, but that not mean I cannot help you too.

I hear word that your head priestess spirit want all Forsaken to come to her--there are things you must learn.

Go to meet Aelthalyste in the War Quarter in that city of yours.
narrative.objectives: Speak to Aelthalyste in the Undercity.
narrative.offerRewardText: Ah, good, another has arrived. Time may not matter to me, but to you it is of the essence. There is much for you to learn and there is much I wish to teach you. You simply must prove your worth. Do that, and you shall be greatly rewarded.
